scripts.network: hc sandbox clean && npm run build:happ && UI_PORT=$(get-port) concurrently "npm run start --workspace ui" "npm run launch:happ"
scripts.package: npm run build:happ && npm run package --workspace ui && hc web-app pack workdir --recursive
scripts.build:happ: npm run build:zomes && hc app pack workdir --recursive
scripts.applet-dev: npm run build:happ && concurrently -k "UI_PORT=8888 npm run start -w ui" "weave --agent-idx 1 --dev-config ./weave.dev.config.ts" "sleep 5 && weave --agent-idx 2 --dev-config ./weave.dev.config.ts --sync-time 20000"
scripts.applet-dev-1: npm run build:happ && concurrently -k "UI_PORT=8888 npm run start -w ui" "weave --agent-idx 1 --dev-config ./weave.dev.config.ts"
